summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing for Health Journal, /health, /blog index, /blog/:slug, SEO meta/JSON-LD injection, nav+footer links, and light commerce regression. 22/24 checks pass. Only failures are edge/ingress serving of public/sitemap.xml (403) and public/robots.txt (serves generic override, not app file).

integration_issues.flow: Static SEO files served from frontend/public/
integration_issues.issue: GET /sitemap.xml returns HTTP 403 Forbidden at preview URL (expected 14-url XML). GET /robots.txt returns 200 but with a generic 1836-byte 'content signals' policy — NOT the 6-line app robots.txt that includes 'Allow: /', 'Disallow: /admin/' and 'Sitemap: .../sitemap.xml'. Ingress/edge appears to intercept these paths before they reach the React dev server, so search engines won't see the intended sitemap or robots rules.

action_items: Investigate why /sitemap.xml returns 403 and /robots.txt is overridden at the preview.emergentagent.com edge — likely ingress or platform-level interception. Files exist correctly in /app/frontend/public/. May need ingress rule or serving via backend /api/sitemap.xml (not preferred for SEO) or documenting that these will work only on the production domain.
Minor a11y: add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to DoctorsNoteDialog (Radix warns 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}').
critical_code_review_comments: Seo.jsx cleanup on unmount removes JSON-LD scripts but leaves meta tags/canonical from previous route in the DOM; subsequent Seo mount overwrites them via upsertMeta, so no user-visible bug, but leaves stale meta briefly between route unmount and remount. Acceptable.
BlogPost.jsx breadcrumb JSON-LD uses relative 'item' paths ('/', '/blog', '/blog/slug'). Google prefers absolute URLs — consider prefixing with window.location.origin or canonical host.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All React-rendered features work: HealthJournal section (4 cards, video src set to mixkit URLs, dialog opens/closes), /health (hero, GI table 6 rows, 6 FAQs, both CTAs), /blog (1 featured + 5 grid = 6 total blog-card- links), /blog/millets-for-diabetes-low-gi-guide (title, meta desc, canonical, 3 JSON-LD blocks Article+FAQPage+BreadcrumbList, 6 h2 sections, CTA→/collections/millets, FAQ accordion, 3 related-post- links, back link), invalid slug shows blog-post-not-found, nav-health and nav-blog work, footer has 'Health Journal'→/health and 'Blog'→/blog. Commerce regression: /collections/best-sellers renders 163 product cards. Videos will look blank in headless Chromium — this is expected and the <source src> attribute is correctly set. Only real issue: /sitemap.xml=403 and /robots.txt returns wrong content at the preview edge (likely platform routing, not app code).
rca_of_the_issue: public/sitemap.xml and public/robots.txt exist with correct content in the repo, but requests to https://shathabdhi-shop.preview.emergentagent.com/{sitemap.xml,robots.txt} do not hit the CRA dev server serving them. sitemap.xml returns 403 (edge deny) and robots.txt returns a generic 1836-byte 'content signals' policy that the app never authored — indicating the preview ingress/CDN layer intercepts these two well-known paths. Fix likely needs to be at ingress config, not app code.
